about.title: An independent platform
about.text: Lentific connects individuals, businesses and investors to finance projects transparently. As independents with no exclusive ties, we compare offers and defend your interests.

points.independent: No lender imposes its offers on us
points.single: A single point of contact from start to finish
points.remote: Video meetings and a 100% online file
points.noFees: Our fees are only due once your loan is obtained

cost.q: How much does a broker cost?
cost.a: Our fees are set in writing at the first meeting and are only due if your loan is obtained. No payment of any kind may be required before one or more loans are obtained.

individuals.q: Can my loan be funded by individuals?
individuals.a: Yes, depending on your project: on our marketplace, investors whose identity we have verified fund projects, with a contract and tracking just like a regular loan. Beware of an "individual" offering you a loan online and asking for fees up front: it is a common scam.

documents.a: ID, last three payslips, last two tax notices, last three bank statements and, if relevant, the sale agreement or quotes. You upload them directly from your space.

delay.q: How long does it take to get my loan?
delay.a: Allow generally four to eight weeks between the first conversation and the loan offer, depending on the lender and how complex your file is. With the "Priority file" option, you can receive your loan within one to three weeks at most. You follow every step online.

remote.a: Yes. Meetings by phone or video, documents sent from your secure space, and live assistance if you get stuck on a step.

investor.headline: Invest your capital faster, with as many introductions as you need
investor.pitch: One contact is not always enough: the borrower may already have found financing, or the project may not quite match your criteria. With Premium, contact as many borrowers as you like, compare projects and decide faster.
features: Unlimited introductions to borrowers, without paying for each contact
Contact several borrowers in parallel to compare projects
Automatic alert as soon as a new application matches your risk tolerance
Fast-track verification of your investor profile, within 48 hours

borrower.headline: Increase your chances of getting your financing quickly
borrower.pitch: Every investor has their own criteria: amount, duration, type of project. If you contact only one investor, you depend on a single answer. With Premium, contact as many investors as you like at the same time: you increase your chances and save precious time.
features: Unlimited introductions to investors, without paying for each contact
Contact several investors at once instead of waiting for answers one after another
Compare the offers and choose the one that suits you best
No commitment: cancel in one click, free of charge
